verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents user-built ingestion workflows, which can be created and edited with natural-language prompts in its AI Editor. Webhooks receive external events and trigger those workflows, and admins can configure AI risk auto-scoring with thresholds. The event-to-action automation shown is limited to data ingestion and risk scoring, not a general rule engine. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event/condition/action rule builder across modules, documented action types beyond ingestion, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
You can use webhooks to: Receive incoming payloads, Trigger ingestion workflows, Process external events
Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
You can configure: AI risk auto-scoring, Risk thresholds and scoring levels
